column1: # Held-out labelled shell commands for safeshell evaluation (written independently of the classifier rules)
# Format: LEVEL<TAB>COMMAND<TAB>SHORT WHY ; levels R0..R4 by reversibility; sudo raises one level
# AMBIGUOUS in WHY marks cases where a reasonable reviewer may differ by one level

column3: AMBIGUOUS dry run flag makes no changes
AMBIGUOUS POST but typically a read query
AMBIGUOUS dest probably new, could overwrite
AMBIGUOUS publishes branch, hard to retract

column2: psql -c "DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expires < now()" mydb
mysql -e "UPDATE users SET active=0 WHERE id=5"

column3: AMBIGUOUS force delete branch, reflog recovers
AMBIGUOUS sudo raises one process kill
